topics.title: 课程作业
topics.summary: 遵守课程、院系或学部规则。2025 年政策要求透明、负责任地使用 AI，并未授予考核通用许可。
topics.scope: 2023 年课程规则指引仅作历史背景，结合 2025 年不端政策阅读；具体考核规则仍待核实。

claims.text: Follow your course, department or faculty rules. The 2025 policy requires transparent, responsible AI use; it does not grant blanket assessment permission.

evidence.quote: How you use generative AI depends on your course, department, or faculty rules, as well as UJ policy.

topics.title: 隐私与数据
topics.summary: 这些来源不足以建立向 AI 输入个人、机密或科研数据的完整规则。
topics.scope: 隐私和数据分类仍是证据缺口，不能据此推定许可。
topics.evidenceGap: Privacy and data classification remain evidence gaps; no permission is inferred. These sources do not establish a complete rule for entering personal, confidential or research data into AI.
topics.evidenceScope: Privacy and data classification remain evidence gaps; no permission is inferred.

topics.title: 机构工具
topics.summary: 本次审核尚未核实当前机构 AI 工具使用资格。
topics.scope: 一般指引提及工具不等于大学许可、授权或考核批准。
topics.evidenceGap: Tool names in general guidance are not evidence of a university licence or assessment approval. No current institutional AI-tool entitlement was established in this audit.
topics.evidenceScope: Tool names in general guidance are not evidence of a university licence or assessment approval.

topics.scope: 适用于研究生研究考核，不能替代完整期刊发表或科研数据政策。

additionalTopics.title: 学术诚信
additionalTopics.summary: 不具备政策所列负责任使用特征的 AI 使用可能构成不端；因效度和可靠性问题，政策目前不建议使用 AI 检测器。
additionalTopics.scope: “可能”须保留条件，“不建议”不能改为全面禁止。政策区分多个不端等级，一级重交的有条件分数上限不能改为统一 AI 处罚；完整程序及申诉规则仍有缺口。

additionalTopics.title: 安全与采购
additionalTopics.summary: 尚未核实当前 AI 采购及安全审批流程。
additionalTopics.scope: 存在学术不端政策不等于已批准供应商或数据安全。
